title: Our Living Environment
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Bedwetting is talked about as something many children go through, never named for a child in class. A child who wets the bed is never shamed or punished; a worried parent is pointed to the school nurse or a health worker (SAFE: teacher to confirm wording).

skills.key_step: The child names bedding found locally (mattress, mat, blanket, sheet, pillow) and says how a sleeping area is kept clean: air and sun, wash, sweep, keep food away.

floor.question: Is a toothbrush a personal item or a common item?

representations: pictures of a mattress, mat, blanket, sheet and pillow
a real blanket aired in the sun
steps: Name things we sleep on and under.
Sort pictures into bedding and not bedding.
Say three ways to keep bedding clean.
Say what to do when bedding gets wet.
contexts: a dormitory at a boarding school
a child sharing a bed with a sibling
a mat in a small one-room house

board.do: Draw a bed with a mat, a blanket and a pillow.

board.say: How do we keep this clean?

board.do: Wait for the child to say wash it or put it in the sun.
Write: air, wash, sweep, no food.

listen_for: None of them, bedding is a mattress
misconceptions.ask: Which of these can be used as bedding? A sisal mat, a cooking pot, a spoon.
misconceptions.repair: Show a mat, a blanket and a gunny-bag mattress. Ask: can you sleep on it or under it? Then it is bedding.

misconceptions.ask: Wanjiru's blanket looks clean. Should she still put it in the sun sometimes?
misconceptions.repair: Smell a blanket aired in the sun and one kept folded for weeks. Say: germs hide where we cannot see.

listen_for: On the bed, then shake it
misconceptions.ask: Where should we eat our food?
misconceptions.repair: Show how crumbs bring ants, cockroaches and rats. Agree: food stays away from where we sleep.

misconceptions.ask: A child wets the bed at night. What should be done with the wet bedding?
misconceptions.repair: Say calmly that many children wet the bed. Wet bedding is washed and dried in the sun; the child bathes. No one is laughed at.

checks.question: Which is bedding: a mat or a plate?
Why do we put a blanket in the sun?
checks.answer: To kill germs and remove smells
